info.title: Geoapify Forward Geocoding API
info.description: Convert free-form or structured addresses into geographic coordinates.

servers.description: EU-focused endpoint. Geoapify service processing uses EU infrastructure.

get.description: Use one input mode: `text` for a free-form address, or one or more structured address parameters (`name`, `housenumber`, `street`, `postcode`, `city`, `state`, `country`). Do not combine `text` with structured address parameters.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Free-form address query. Alternative to the structured address parameters; do not combine them.
parameters.example: 200 Larkin Street, San Francisco, CA 94102, United States

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Place or amenity name. Structured address input; do not use with `text`.

parameters.name: housenumber
parameters.description: House number. Structured address input; do not use with `text`.

parameters.name: street
parameters.description: Street name. Structured address input; do not use with `text`.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: Postcode or ZIP code. Structured address input; do not use with `text`.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City name. Structured address input; do not use with `text`.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State or region name. Structured address input; do not use with `text`.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country name. Structured address input; do not use with `text`.
